amber.benefit: Adds DataCite version relationships and discovery beyond Crossref/OSTI.
amber.location: Release or publication stages; canonical version and sequential version examples
amber.why_material: Official documentation supports IsVersionOf/HasVersion and IsNewVersionOf. This gives a concrete route to recognize repository/preprint versions that Crossref relationships alone may miss; no actual additional DAC item was demonstrated.

teal.benefit: Provides an independently verifiable real correction fixture with the affected study, location, numeric change and notice date.
teal.location: Published date line 19; correction target/paragraph lines 43-44
teal.why_material: The publisher confirms the example. A reader can validate a notice ledger against a substantive changed estimate rather than only a generic XML schema. Amber's XML is also a legitimate documented schema, so this earns a slight rather than material preference.

verification_limits: Live API reads failed independently through both web and local urllib: web reported inaccessible URLs; urllib reported Errno 8 DNS resolution failures. This corroborates present environment limitations, not an exact historical tool trace or worldwide API outage.

No live regional harvest, QGIS execution, PDF rendering, scheduler, literature recall or deduplication accuracy measurement was possible. Recommendations and synthetic fixture checks are distinct from successful real-data operation.

Only assigned packets and protocol were inspected. Original answers and evidence were preserved. No accounts, installs, credentials, remote writes, other reviews or arm identity information were used.
